mapper.select: SELECT SLA. ID, SLA.BADGE, SLA. NAME, SLA.COMP_NAME, SLA.DEP_NAME, SLA.JCHEN_NAME, SLA.JOB_NAME, SLA.LEAVE_TYPE, SLA.LEAVE_REASON, SLA.LEAVE_TIME, SLA.JOIN_TIME, SLA.YEAR_HOLIDAY, SLA.EZID, SLA.PROCESS_ID, SLA.LEAVE_STATUS, SLA.APPROVE_STATUS, SLA.EID FROM SMT_LEAVE_APPLICATION SLA WHERE SLA.PROCESS_ID = #{processId}
SELECT SS.PHONE FROM SMT_STAFF SS WHERE SS.BADGE = #{badge}

SELECT V_SPR.TITLE, V_SPR.NODE_NAME, V_SPR.NODE_STATE, V_SPR.LEAVE_TIME, V_SPR.RECORD_DATE, V_SPR.PROCESS_ID, V_SPR."ID", V_SPR.LEAVE_STATUS, V_SPR."NAME", V_SPR.APPROVE_STATUS, V_SPR.CREATE_TIME, V_SPR.RN FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER () OVER ( PARTITION BY SPRF.PROCESS_ID ORDER BY SPRF.ORDER_ID DESC ) RN, SPRF.TITLE, SPRF.NODE_NAME, SPRF.NODE_STATE, SPRF.LEAVE_TIME, SPRF.RECORD_DATE, SPRF.PROCESS_ID, SPRF."ID", SPRF.LEAVE_STATUS, SPRF."NAME", SPRF.Badge, SPRF.APPROVE_STATUS, SPRF.CREATE_TIME, SPRF.ORDER_ID FROM ( SELECT CONCAT (SLA. NAME, '离职申请') AS TITLE, SPR.NODE_NAME, SPR.STATUS AS NODE_STATE, SLA.LEAVE_TIME, SPR.RECORD_DATE, SLA.PROCESS_ID, SLA."ID", SLA.LEAVE_STATUS, SLA."NAME", SLA.Badge, SLA.APPROVE_STATUS, SLA.CREATE_TIME, SPR."ID" AS ORDER_ID FROM SMT_LEAVE_APPLICATION SLA LEFT JOIN SMT_PROCESS_RECORD SPR ON SLA.PROCESS_ID = SPR.PROCESS_ID WHERE SLA.APPLY_BADGE = #{badge} AND SLA.LEAVE_STATUS = #{leaveStatus}
) SPRF ) V_SPR WHERE V_SPR.RN = 1 ORDER BY V_SPR.CREATE_TIME DESC
